title: Microsoft Copilot: build interactive reports and dashboards with Pages
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap targets, existing Pages controls and licensing statements are supported. It reports Microsoft's conflicting storage and Notebooks licensing documentation and keeps the new capability's undocumented rollout and agent behaviour open.

claims.claim: The Graph TCM operation is preview.

claims.claim: The target setting must not be configured in any group-level policy for TCM.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: An inline baseline with mode applyOnce applies desired settings once.
claims.quote:
baseline ... The desired-state baseline. Required for an inline-baseline monitor.
mode ... The possible values are: monitorOnly, applyOnce, unknownFutureValue.
An active applyOnce monitor runs in the background ... and then becomes inactive.

claims.claim: The TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite for applyOnce.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, grant it the CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite delegated permission.
